title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Brittany Butler is the founding Executive Director of the Social Innovation and Change Initiative (SICI) and an Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School. Her teaching and writing focus on purpose-driven leadership and effective strategies for initiating and implementing system-level change. She equips students and practitioners with practical tools, research-informed insights, and real-world examples to help them build personalized strategies for delivering on the results they care most about.
